You tell it what you are working on, and it blocks anything unrelated for as long as that task is active. No schedules, no resets. YouTube is made task-safe instead of fully blocked by hiding Shorts, recommendations, comments, autoplay, and thumbnails, while keeping useful search results and videos. Everything runs locally with a simple setup and clear blocking logic.

name: ZenTrack - AI Habit & Focus Tracker
tagline: AI-powered habit tracker that learns your daily patterns
description: ZenTrack combines habit tracking with focus timers and AI insights. Build lasting habits, track Pomodoro sessions, and get personalized recommendations based on your actual behavior.

name: Zilsesleri Pro
tagline: ZilSesleri Pro, en iyi çözümleri ve en iyi çözümleri sunuyor
description: ZilSesleri Pro, kullanıcıların cep telefonları için ücretsiz zil sesleri aramasına ve indirmesine yardımcı olan bir web sitesidir. Günlük olarak güncellenen çeşitli türlerde geniş bir zil sesi kütüphanesi bulunmaktadır.

name: Zinggit
tagline: Capture ideas with your voice and turn them into content
description: Most content tools start with a blank page. Zinggit starts with your voice. Speak a half-formed idea and Zinggit transcribes it, cleans it up, and turns it into a blog post, LinkedIn post, newsletter, YouTube script, or short reel. All in the same voice you actually speak in. Built for founders, consultants, and marketers who have more ideas than time. No more losing thoughts between the idea and the draft. Just speak it, Zinggit it, publish it. Free to try. No credit card.

name: ZoZo
tagline: iPhone & iPad Keyboard Shortcuts at your fingertips
description: ZoZo is a new iOS Shortcut app that allows you to create shortcuts accessible right from your keyboard for the pictures, text phrases, URL's & Documents you share the most.
